gloss.en: A conjecture we intend to test; no evidence yet.
gloss.zh: 我们打算测试的猜想；目前尚无证据。

gloss.en: Survives the strongest test applied so far, within its stated scope.
gloss.zh: 在其声明的范围内，经受住了迄今最严格的检验。

gloss.en: Evidence is partial, mixed, descriptive or same-engine only.
gloss.zh: 证据不完整、混合、仅为描述性或仅同一引擎内自洽。

gloss.en: A gate written in advance was not met.
gloss.zh: 预先设定的通过线未达到。

gloss.en: The registered rule declined to issue a verdict (for example, no model had the required physics).
gloss.zh: 登记的规则拒绝给出结论（例如没有模型具备所需的物理）。

gloss.en: We tested it and falsified it ourselves.
gloss.zh: 我们已测试并自行证伪。

gloss.en: We published it, then found a confounder and retracted the strong form.
gloss.zh: 我们发表后发现了混淆因素，并撤回了较强形式。

gloss.en: We stopped claiming it, or relabelled it as not evidence.
gloss.zh: 我们不再主张此结论，或已将其重新标记为非证据。

entries.title: Hyper-Ribbon Universality
entries.subtitle: Descriptive only: historical spectra show concentrated elastic errors; counts not re-verified; universality and correction value unproven.

entries.title: Hyper-Ribbon Transfers Classical → MLIP
entries.subtitle: Cross-paradigm ribbon transfer — per-element counts under re-audit after Born screening (2026-06); directional structure confirmed at 8–11 models.

entries.title: Cross-MLIP Orthogonal Error Modes
entries.subtitle: MACE and CHGNet fail in orthogonal directions — the precondition for ensembling.

entries.title: Au Escapes the Ribbon Under MLIPs
entries.subtitle: Confirmed for MACE + CHGNet; Ag escape refuted. Mechanism open.

entries.title: Fe Magnetic MLIP Failure Mode
entries.subtitle: The old PR > 2 trio claim is frozen after Born screening; Fe remains a spin/mechanical-stability target.

entries.title: D-Band Controls Error Correlation
entries.subtitle: Refuted — full-sample ρ = −0.02; the signal was a sample-size confounder.

entries.title: MEAM Is Intrinsically 2-D
entries.subtitle: Refuted by matched-n bootstrap; a narrower bounded claim survives.

entries.title: The BCC/FCC "Causal Shield"
entries.subtitle: Self-corrected — the dramatic r 0.90 vs 0.04 was 1.5% data contamination.

entries.title: The Three Error-Geometry Objects
entries.subtitle: Model manifold vs. participation-ratio measure vs. configuration-space core — kept straight.

entries.title: Methodology — How We Know, and How We Catch Ourselves
entries.subtitle: Matched-n, contamination gating, ecological-fallacy stratification — the reusable discipline.

entries.title: Z1 Barrier-Accurate MLIP Campaign — Round-4 Results (Two Precision Chains)
entries.subtitle: Failed on both precision chains — all four models miss the 40 meV gate (135–243 meV) identically under float32 and float64; signed-error imbalance is model-dependent, not universal.

entries.title: Z3 Δ-Learned Adsorption Accuracy — Round-4 Results
entries.subtitle: Failed — 128/128 baseline measurements; every validation-selected correction worsened the holdout (2.27–5.91 eV vs the 0.1 eV gate).

entries.title: Z2 Spin-Aware Campaign — Abstention Audit
entries.subtitle: Spin runner, locked panel, and ClaimContract exist; this four-row pipeline smoke deliberately abstains with zero scientific executions while the SOC/Tc campaign remains owner-gated.

entries.title: Round-4 Elastic Correction — Results and Preregistration Amendment
entries.subtitle: Confirmatory fail (0/4, 0/1) with the post-lock violation recorded void and repaired; B0 descriptive-only; zero verdict changes.

entries.title: MLIP Cloud Baseline and Distill: First Real 5x5 Results
entries.subtitle: Cloud Run completed the 25-cell MLIP baseline and produced the first backend-diverse Distill energy wins.

entries.title: Ni Paired Accuracy Report
entries.subtitle: Baseline-versus-Distill accuracy evidence for the Ni fcc EAM-home-turf campaign.

entries.title: Ni Zero-Point Policy Replay
entries.subtitle: Local Rust replay turns the Ni promotion canary green before a Cloud Run image rebuild.

entries.title: MPtrj Broad-DFT MLIP Canary
entries.subtitle: Support-floor v2 improves MACE, ORB, and SevenNet while CHGNet safely holds: six wins, two holds, zero regressions.

entries.title: Round 2 Preregistration — MatPES MLIP Elastic Constants
entries.subtitle: Pre-registered protocol: 16 cubic elements, four MatPES potentials, two functionals, and the operator-correction kill conditions.

entries.title: Round 2 Results — MatPES MLIP Elastic Constants across 16 Cubic Elements
entries.subtitle: Working draft. Its registered hypotheses were later evaluated: H1/H2a kills triggered, H2b and H4 coverage missed their thresholds. Read the status banner first.

entries.title: The Environment Error Field — Manuscript
entries.subtitle: Nine fcc metals: a field fitted to three observables predicted the never-fitted (110) surface-energy error at r = 0.906 across 36 cells (null centred near 0.44; significant for three of four models).

entries.title: Y-Matrix Cross-Property Pre-Registration
entries.subtitle: Registered hypotheses, coupling-aware nulls, kill conditions — with preserved amendments including a same-day falsified Fe hypothesis.

entries.title: Y-Matrix Confirmatory Results — Rounds 1–2
entries.subtitle: Linear cross-property structure absent under honest nulls; defect/bulk split 15–60×; OMat retraining removes bias, not variance.

entries.title: The Monotone Reparameterization Hypothesis
entries.subtitle: Order right, size wrong: the family-owned warp of foundation-model error, its confirmed predictions, and its registered kill conditions.

entries.title: The Formalization Ladder
entries.subtitle: L0 receipts to L3 verified routing: making the proof kernel part of the research loop, with typed claim-shapes replacing threshold theater.

entries.title: Layer 2 Supercell Scaling Evaluation
entries.subtitle: Technical memo: elastic constants are converged at the 1×1×1 conventional cell; 3×3×3 adds runtime without accuracy gain.

entries.title: MatPES MLIP Elastic Constants: A 16-Element Benchmark
entries.subtitle: Draft research paper covering methods, results, and implications for machine-learning interatomic potentials.

entries.title: MLIP Elastic Benchmark Preprint
entries.subtitle: 1×1×1 conventional-cell accuracy matches 3×3×3 at ~4× lower cost; operator failure diagnosis.

entries.title: MLIP Elastic Benchmark Protocol
entries.subtitle: Reusable protocol for the MatPES cubic-metal 16-element elastic-constant benchmark.

entries.title: Operator Failure Diagnosis
entries.subtitle: Why the LOO-PCA bias operator degraded MAE and what scalar-bulk operator v0.2 learned instead.

entries.title: Layer-2: A Sub-Core-Hour 3×3×3 Elastic-Constant Reference Benchmark for MatPES MLIPs
entries.subtitle: 16 cubic metals, four MatPES MLIP labels, 128 cases (r2SCAN targets approximate): raw 17.84 GPa; 10.36 GPa as an oracle ceiling. Not a deployable correction.

entries.title: The Open Distillation Factory — Executable Vision
entries.subtitle: Lean 4 checks the arithmetic and stated inequalities behind published numbers; it does not check the physics, the reference data or the pipeline. Generated inventory: 927 declarations, zero active sorry (counted 2026-11-12).

entries.title: Z1 Sparse-DFT Pilot — Union-Anchor Economics
entries.subtitle: Projected accounting, no new DFT: 154 instead of 558 projected DFT evaluations on 29 analyzable paths (72.4% fewer). The baseline is four separate runs; paths have 5–7 images, so the union covers 154 of 167 images.

entries.title: Citation Identifier Verification — Nine Savings Digests
entries.subtitle: Identifier audit for the savings-stack digests: 115/115 arXiv IDs and 48/48 DOI strings verified against the arXiv API and Crossref, with corrections applied.

entries.title: Z1 Union Campaign — Verdict of Record (2026-07-24)
entries.subtitle: Sparse-versus-dense GPAW self-consistency across 23 active paths: 0.0–6.8 meV mean error. VASP-referenced error is 693.0–705.7 meV; no external-reference accuracy win.

entries.title: Z1 Union Campaign — Measured Cost Ledger (2026-07-24)
entries.subtitle: Recorded ledger: 129 anchors, 61.0 wall-hours, 244 vCPU-hours. The campaign retains an unresolved cost-provenance conflict; estimates are not a verified bill.

entries.title: T1 Niggli Audit — Path-15 Cell-Representation Check (2026-07-24)
entries.subtitle: VALID: raw vs Niggli-reduced cells shift absolute energies ~39 eV but the barrier moves only 3.5 meV — the third recorded offset-cancellation instance; no anchor recomputation needed.

entries.title: T1 Wander Mechanism — Metallic Saddles and SCF Fragility (2026-07-22)
entries.subtitle: Path-0 diagnostic: the GPAW↔VASP offset wander is intrinsic to metallic, near-zero-gap saddles rather than a settings artifact; the adopted settings are validated as converged on the worst-behaved path.

entries.title: T1 — The Convention-Wander Gate
entries.subtitle: Gate semantics for cross-engine barrier comparisons: |barrier_A − barrier_B| ≤ offset wander, so wander above the 40 meV gate downgrades a VASP-referenced verdict to convention-contaminated.
